mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending weakness pressures corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production signals an impending manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate output growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and real GDP growth signal a broad-based supply-side slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in retail sales indicates weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate revenue growth falters.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during post-shock recovery when RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
